nodes.label: Hermes Agent Architecture
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive documentation detailing autonomous 24/7 WhatsApp AI assistant deployed on GCP Compute Engine VM e2-medium with zero phone dependency.

nodes.label: 100% Reactive Architecture Principle
nodes.rationale: Design decision decommissioning proactive automated morning (6:00 AM) and lunch (3:00 PM) schedulers to ensure zero unsolicited outbound messages and strictly event-driven replies.

nodes.label: Contact Whitelist & Isolation Matrix
nodes.rationale: Multi-identifier verification cascade (phone, LID, pushname, chat title) ensuring zero persona bleed and total privacy across Himanshi, Father (Dilip Singh), and Mother personas while dropping unknown contacts.

nodes.label: Watchdog Resilience Pattern
nodes.rationale: Tolerates transient Chromium frame detachment and out-of-sandbox re-render errors across 30-second cycles, triggering PM2 process reboot only after confirmed threshold.

nodes.label: Multi-Device Phone Pairing Protocol
nodes.rationale: Alternative linking method bypassing camera QR rate-limiting by requesting an official 8-digit OTP code via client.requestPairingCode().

nodes.label: 24/7 Presence Engine Simulation
nodes.rationale: Synthesizes window focus and document visibilitychange events every 12 seconds inside Chromium to sustain permanent online availability.

nodes.label: Compute Engine Performance Topology
nodes.rationale: Memory hierarchy on e2-medium combining 4GB RAM, ZRAM compressed in-memory swap with zstd, and 2GB disk swap to prevent Linux OOM-killer termination.
